evidence.note: translateLevel projects one ColorSupportLevel into the implied stack and the same level field: level 0 is ColorInfo false; levels 1, 2, and 3 write hasBasic with has256 iff level>=2 and has16m iff level>=3.
Browser constructors write only truecolor (level 3, all three flags) and basic (level 1, hasBasic only).

notes: Cardinality correction of color-support-level-flags: the same owner also stores ColorSupportLevel 0|1|2|3, so representable is 8 flag tuples times 4 levels. Producers still support only the three implied stacks.

evidence.note: findMinimalFold writes exhausted with noMatch, ambiguous with match none, a unique match, or neither flag with match none, and never sets both flags.
bestAlignedMatch returns on exhausted, else on ambiguous, and only then reads match; there is no combined-true arm.
Either flag implies the other flag is false and match is none.

notes: Seed listed match as a boolean. match is Option<MatchedText>, so representable is 4 flag pairs times some/none. UniqueMatchSearch itself has only ambiguous and is not a second cluster.
